note: The trailer of « Louis's Round » (src/trailer.js, briefs/trailer.md): a real session, nothing staged. Each step starts, then `hold` seconds pass (times the pace: ?pace=1.3 or `pace` here) before the next. `say` is sent through the story's input port as if typed; `time` lets world time pass, `speed` times faster (a ×N mark shows it); `camera` is where the player looks during its hold (the gaze is the real input: looking at a thing long enough is an observation; at the trailhead she looks away from the first mark so that the player asks for it); `caption` is one idea at a time (`*x*` is highlighted; `text_reflex` is shown instead while no model has decided anything); `show` reveals the live read-outs. Tune the holds on a real GPU: voices and transitions take longer there than lines on paper.

kicker.fr: Une expérience procédurale pilotée par l'IA

text.en: This is the engine running, not a video.
text.fr: C'est le moteur qui tourne, pas une vidéo.

say.en: Leave the trail. Cut through the trees.
say.fr: Quitte le sentier, coupe à travers les arbres.

say.en: Then follow the orange marks, please.
say.fr: Alors suis les marques orange, s'il te plaît.

text.en: If you can say it, *it can happen.*
text.fr: Si tu peux le dire, *ça peut arriver.*

text_reflex.en: Image and sound: *generated by code,* live.
text_reflex.fr: Image et son : *générés par le code,* en direct.

text.en: The present answers at once. *The scene and the story take their time.*
text.fr: Le présent répond tout de suite. *La scène et l'histoire prennent leur temps.*
Tu ne peux pas agir. *Tu peux prévoir.*

say.en: If the jay calls, stop and lie down.
say.fr: Si le geai crie, arrête-toi et couche-toi.

say.en: Whatever you hear down there, don't move and don't speak.
say.fr: Quoi que tu entendes en bas, ne bouge pas et ne parle pas.

text.en: Authors write *patterns and rules,* in words.
text.fr: Les auteurs écrivent *des motifs et des règles,* avec des mots.
